ABOUT ME
Transforming Data into
Meaningful Insights.
Hello! I'm Varsha A, a 2026 graduate in Artificial Intelligence
              and Machine Learning from KPR College of Arts Science and Research.
I enjoy transforming data into meaningful insights through Data Science, Machine Learning, and Data Analytics. I build practical, data-driven solutions, continuously enhance my technical skills, and enjoy solving real-world problems using modern technologies.
My primary strengths lie in Python, SQL, Excel, Power BI,
              and Python libraries including Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib,
              and Seaborn.
I also have experience in web scraping using BeautifulSoup
              and Selenium, allowing me to collect and analyze data efficiently.
Beyond technical skills, I value continuous learning, effective communication, and teamwork. I enjoy taking on new challenges, building practical projects, and expanding my knowledge to create impactful, data-driven solutions.
